name: Upflow MCP
description:
Upflow is a B2B accounts receivable and payments platform that helps finance teams get paid faster. The Upflow MCP connector brings your AR data directly into Claude, so you can ask questions and take action without leaving the conversation. With Upflow MCP, you can:
- Look up customer accounts, invoice status, and payment history
- Track outstanding balances and aging receivables across your portfolio
- Get context on collections activity and promise-to-pay commitments
- Query cash application and payment matching data
- Surface trends across your organization's AR performance

Built for finance and revenue teams already using Upflow, this connector turns Claude into a natural-language interface for your receivables workflow — ask a question the way you'd ask a colleague, and get an answer grounded in your live Upflow data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Upflow MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Upflow MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.upflow.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Upflow MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upflow MCP provides these MCP tools: describe_upflow_api, list_organizations, and query_upflow_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Upflow MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Upflow MCP in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Upflow MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upflow MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Upflow MCP is developed by Upflow, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
